profile.headline: Professional Behavior Consultant | Full Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary: Recent Hackbright Academy graduate ready to pursue new adventures in software engineering! Previous career involved animal behavior and training in many sectors including private, academia, and corporate; building strong skillsets in both one-on-one coaching and team development. Excited to bring past experience and knowledge into tech!

positions.title: Dog Trainer and Behavior Consultant
positions.description:
• Virtual one-on-one pet behavior consultations, increasing accessibility and clientele across the country.
• Private one-on-one training lessons to “tag-teach” pet parents how to effectively train their dog using classical and counter conditioning, operant conditioning, and positive reinforcement techniques.
• Board and Train programs, providing faster results for more intensive behavior modification cases.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Developer (student)
positions.description:
• Python | HTML | Javascript | Flask | Jinja | PostgreSQL | Bootstrap | CSS 
• Developed a pet professional search site using PostgreSQL database, Flask, & Python to provide a simple user experience for finding qualified pet professionals in their area
• Utilized Yelp and Javascript Map APIs to provide additional data and enhance user experience
• Integrated Bootstrap for increased responsive design

positions.title: Python Engineer (student)
positions.description:
• Python | Command Line
• Created command-line text-adventure game, allowing gamer to interact and change story line.

positions.title: Area Services Manager
positions.description:
• Oversee Training and Grooming departments company-wide (9 locations across Northern and Southern California)
• Sales managerial duties: Develop and drive department revenue sales by establishing new programs that generate profitable income in training and grooming. Track sales revenues as it relates to labor budgets, operational costs, and sales goals for each locations.
• Ensure quality and consistent production of services.
• Work with General Managers of each facility location to interview, hire, train and develop new trainers/groomers.
• Develop and enforce all policies and procedures in training/grooming.
• Develop and implement continued education programs to support the growth of training and grooming associates.
• Create and manage trainer mentorship program, assign educational readings and projects, and track program progress. All participants in trainer development program are prepared to take a third-party exam (CCPDT) in as little as 1 year, to become a professionally certified dog trainer.
• Implement dog behavior training for all associates in company (daycare, boarding, client services, grooming, training, and management)

positions.title: Senior Dog Trainer and Behavior Consultant
positions.description:
• All duties associated with the role of Dog Trainer and Behavior Consultant, in addition to:
• Active Mentor in the trainer development and mentorship program; take on apprentice trainers from Northern California facilities and aid them in their journey to become CPDT certified.
• Assist in the interviewing and staffing of trainers in all Northern and Southern facilities.
• Develop and drive department revenue sales by establishing new programs that generate profitable income in training. Track sales revenues as it relates to sales goals for all locations (north and south).

positions.title: Dog Trainer and Behavior Consultant
positions.description:
•Formulate positive-reinforcement based training plans catered to each client individual needs. Once implemented, create an in depth behavior modification report for clients, detailing training processes used with their pet dog and how to best continue the program at home.
•Provide consultation, private training lessons, group classes and “board and train” programs for pet dog owners looking for behavior modification in their pet dog.
•Assist in general animal husbandry duties throughout the hotel during non-training hours, such as enclosure cleaning, medicating, exercising, and food preparation.
•Provide training services and enrichment activities for boarding guests in need of extra mental stimulation.
•Basic obedience, agility, fear-aggression, leash reactivity, counter conditioning and desensitization.
•Professionally Certified through CCPDT since March 2017

positions.title: Assistant Marine Mammal Trainer
positions.description:
• Animal husbandry of Atlantic bottle nose dolphins, a Hawaiian Monk seal, Southern sea otters, and exotic birds. 
• Duties include diet preparation, assisting in medical procedures/administration, desensitization, enrichment, data collection/record keeping, and knowledge of and adherence to APHIS (Animal and Plant Health Inspection Services) and USDA regulations. 
• Animal training includes behavior maintenance and modification via positive reinforcement and operant conditioning. 
• Facility responsibilities include office/tank/enclosure cleaning, water testing/manipulation, and knowledge of water filtration systems and operations. 
• Mentor/train new volunteers. Assist in Ocean Explorers summer camp, guiding children through the lab with demonstrations and talks. Lead public tours/discussions about the laboratory and associative research and conservation goals. 
• All employees are required to complete an animal husbandry and training lecture series followed by an intensive analytical and situational exam.

company.name: The Marine Mammal Physiology Project at Long Marine Laboratory, UCSC

positions.title: Independent Living Skills Instructor
positions.description: Monarch's goal is to teach and train adults with developmental disabilities to become more independent than they currently are. We are committed to empowering individuals to make their own choices by expressing their preferences and reaching their own goals. We provide 1:1 teaching and training as often and for long as it is needed, both in the community and within the home.

positions.title: Research Field and Lab Assistant for Zavaleta Lab
positions.description: Field assistants collect both biological and geological samples from the field and transport to Zavaleta lab, where species identification and chemical analysis are completed. After analyses, assistants perform detailed data entry to be used in an on going research study of the anthropological effects on serpentine soils and associative flora (both local and invasive).
